# DM Cash Buyers

> Local cash home buyer serving the Des Moines, Iowa metro area. We buy
> single-family homes, condos, townhomes, and small multifamily for cash,
> close in 7-30 days, and pay all closing costs. No agent commissions,
> no repair credits, no contingencies. Locally operated, funded with our
> own capital — not a national iBuyer.

## Service area

Des Moines metro and surrounding Polk, Dallas, and Warren counties, Iowa.
Primary cities:

- Des Moines (50309-50327)
- West Des Moines (50265, 50266)
- Ankeny (50021, 50023)
- Urbandale (50322, 50323)
- Johnston (50131)
- Waukee (50263)
- Clive (50325)
- Altoona (50009)
- Pleasant Hill, Norwalk, Bondurant, Grimes, Indianola, Carlisle,
  Windsor Heights, Mitchellville, Polk City

## Offer terms

- Free, no-obligation written cash offer within 24 hours
- Close in as fast as 7 days, typical close 14-30 days
- Properties bought as-is — no repair credits, no inspection
  re-negotiations
- DM Cash Buyers pays all closing costs (typical retail-side closing
  fees waived for the seller)
- We use our own capital — no financing contingencies, no appraisal
  contingencies
- Closing at a local Polk County title company

## Seller situations we work with

- Pre-foreclosure (Iowa is a judicial foreclosure state; we close
  before sheriff's sale to preserve credit + equity)
- Inherited / probate houses (we work with executors and out-of-state
  heirs; Polk County District Court probate)
- Divorce sales (Iowa equitable distribution; both parties cash out
  same date)
- Distressed / as-is properties (fire damage, code violations,
  hoarding, foundation, storm damage, long-vacant)
- Job relocations (Principal Financial, Wells Fargo, John Deere,
  Hy-Vee corporate transfers)
- Tired landlords and investor exits
- Estate sales of mid-century homes with deferred maintenance

## When a cash sale is not the right choice

If the property is in good condition, the seller has time for a 60-90
day MLS listing, and there are no urgency factors (foreclosure, divorce
timeline, out-of-state heirs, condition issues) — a traditional listing
with a local agent will typically net the seller more after costs.
We'll say so on the first call when that's the right answer.

## What we are not

We are not realtors. We do not list properties on the MLS. We are a
professional home-buying operation purchasing with our own funds.
